character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Full-body pixel art character of a young male university student, around 20 years old, with a slim build, light warm skin, messy dark brown hair and long uneven bangs. Calm, slightly tired expression. Wearing an oversized muted plum-gray hoodie with the hood down, dark charcoal trousers and simple dark sneakers. Large dark over-ear headphones with subtle purple accents rest around his neck. A charcoal backpack with a small muted red diamond patch is worn over both shoulders.  Standing in a relaxed idle pose, arms at his sides, facing the viewer. Slightly elevated camera angle for a top-down adventure game. Clear silhouette, simplified details readable at a small sprite size. Resurrect 64 palette, muted colors, one-pixel dark outline in #2e222f, light from the upper left, compact pixel clusters, crisp edges. Transparent background. Single character, no scenery, no furniture, no laptop, no text, no blur or anti-aliasing.
